findings.statement: The constrained delay-history control supplies a reproducible5ms native-voltage predictor across held acquisition traces.

reliability.rationale: Whole-trace confirmation supports flexible delay prediction (0.109 V) and a DC-invariant harmonic recurrence (0.133 V) relative to persistence (0.439 V), with six held acquisitions. Claim-specific conclusion: The constrained delay-history control supplies a reproducible5ms native-voltage predictor across held acquisition traces.

mechanism.rationale: The harmonic-plus-constant recurrence has coefficients summing to one, so offset invariance is algebraically justified. Its empirical performance does not identify an exact linear oscillator or a new drag law.
